name: Facets Missing Merge
description: A Facets build-stage processor that merges the 'missing' (no-value) facet item into an existing facet item, folding its count and filters and relabelling the target as 'Target (or None)'.
project_description: Facets Missing Merge provides a single Facets processor (plugin id 'missing_item_merge', class Drupal\facets_missing_merge\Plugin\facets\processor\MissingItemMergeProcessor) that runs in the Facets 'build' stage (weight 5). When a facet has its 'missing' option enabled, Facets adds an extra 'missing' item collecting all results that have no value for the faceted field. This processor merges that missing item onto a configured target facet item: it adds the missing item's count to the target's count, removes the target's raw value from the missing item's list of missing filters, and relabels the merged item as 'Target (or None)'. The target is chosen by a single 'Target item' textfield that matches against a result's raw value OR display value. It must be ordered before the URL processor in the build phase because it modifies the missing filter parameters. The module ships only the processor plugin plus its config schema; it declares no routes, permissions, services, forms, entities or Drush commands.
